'''Garden Upgrade I''' is a blueprint that can be build in the [[Garden]]. It can only be built once.

Once built, it increases the base Bed Quality by {{Mastery|Green|+4}} (instead of +2) and reduces the tick length to 1:45 (from 2:00). It also increases the available space for building [[Garden Bed|Garden Beds]] from 10 to 20. Additionally, it unlocks the [[Garden Upgrade II]] [[technology]].
